NEET UG 2026 Counselling Round 1 Choice Filling Deadline Extended

The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) has extended the deadline for choice filling for Round 1 of the NEET UG 2026 counselling. The portal for option editing and choice filling, which was initially set to close earlier, will now remain open until August 18. This extension provides candidates with additional time to finalize their selections for medical college admissions.
